position: MECHANICAL VERDICT: PASS on V1-V5 as written, and the PASS is ROBUST to every single-trial deletion (20/20) and every single-cell deletion (4/4). The only criterion with headroom structure is V3(b) (0.9277 vs 0.80); it tolerates 13 additional starved reserve events = 3 fully-starved 4-reserve trials, breaching on the 4th. V1, V2, V4 all sit at their CEILING (20/20) and therefore carry zero information about where their thresholds bite. One cell evaluated ALONE is below V3(b): T_lo = 18/23 = 0.7826 < 0.80. The pooled PASS is not CARRIED by any one cell (all 4 cell-drops keep V3b >= 0.9047), but all 6 non-both_paths_open events sit in only 3 trials, 2 of them in T_lo.

loo_sensitivity.method: For each of the 20 trials: drop it, recompute V1,V2,V3a,V3b,V3c,V4,V5 on the remaining 19 from raw env_events.
loo_sensitivity.denominator_treatment: V1 and V2 applied FRACTION-BASED exactly as the parenthetical defines them (>=0.80 of valid trials), i.e. >=0.80*19 = 15.2 -> >=16 of 19. V4 applied as the ABSOLUTE count it is literally written as ('>=6/20 valid trials'), i.e. the threshold stays 6 even at n=19. BOTH READINGS WERE COMPUTED.
loo_sensitivity.alternate_reading_effect: NONE. V1=19/19 and V2=19/19 under every deletion, so the >=16-absolute and >=0.80-fraction readings coincide. V4=19/19 under every deletion, so the absolute >=6 reading and a >=0.30-fraction reading coincide. The ambiguity is UNRESOLVED IN THE TEXT but EMPIRICALLY INERT here only because all three criteria sit at ceiling; it would matter immediately if any of them were near threshold.
loo_sensitivity.flipping_trials: NONE. No deletion flips any of V1,V2,V3a,V3b,V3c,V4,V5.

worst_case_V3a_after_deletion.note: V3a cannot fail by one deletion; margin is 63 events

v3b_margin.question_as_asked: holding the numerator (77) FIXED, how many ADDITIONAL non-both_paths_open reserve events drive the share below 0.80?
v3b_margin.margin_in_events_plain: 13 additional starved reserve events can be absorbed; the 14th breaches V3(b).

trial_unit_conversion.per_trial_reserve_counts: 19 of 20 trials have EXACTLY 4 reserve events; exp010_v21_pilot-T_lo-005 has 7. Counts are NOT all equal, so the trial-margin depends on the unit.
trial_unit_conversion.range_statement: 2 to 3 fully-starved trials, depending on unit: 3 if the added trials each carry the modal 4 reserve events, 2 if they carry 7 like T_lo-005 (1 at 7 + 1 at 4 still passes at 0.8191; adding a second 4 breaches at 0.7857).

v3b_margin.margin_plain: V3(b) margin = 13 additional starved reserve events, equivalently 3 fully-starved modal (4-reserve) trials, or as few as 2 fully-starved trials if they are high-reserve like T_lo-005.

alternative_framing_reclassification.note: If instead EXISTING both_paths_open==true events were reclassified to false (total held at 83), at most 10 flips are tolerated (67/83=0.8072); the 11th breaches (66/83=0.7952).

v3b_margin.comparison_to_predata_commitment: decisions/D013.json review item 11 recorded PRE-DATA that 'V3(b) >= 0.80 pooled tolerates ~8 starved events, about 2 fully-starved low-budget trials'. The OBSERVED tolerance is LARGER: 13 events / 3 modal trials. The pre-data estimate was CONSERVATIVE; the observed run has more headroom than the pre-registered worry anticipated. This is a PREREGISTERED robustness concern that the data does not vindicate as a near-miss.
v3b_margin.caveat: This is a pooled-ratio sensitivity exercise, not an estimate of sampling error. n=5/cell supports no inference; D013 and the candidate spec forbid any behavioral claim from these 20 trials.

per_cell.method: All criteria recomputed within each cell (5 trials each) from raw env_events.

concentration_of_starved_events.detail: All 6 non-both_paths_open reserve events sit in 3 of 20 trials: exp010_v21_pilot-T_lo-005 (4 events), exp010_v21_pilot-T_lo-003 (1), exp010_v21_pilot-N_lo-004 (1). 17 of 20 trials have ZERO starved reserve events. 5 of the 6 starved events are in budget-15 (lo) cells; 4 of 6 in T_lo alone. 0 of 6 in either budget-24 (hi) cell.
concentration_of_starved_events.budget_pattern: Starved events appear only in budget-15 cells (N_lo 1, T_lo 5; N_hi 0, T_hi 0). This is a DESCRIPTIVE pattern at n=5/cell and is EXPLORATORY; no budget effect may be claimed (specs/candidates/exp010_v21_instrument_validation.json makes_no_hypothesis_verdict; D013).

any_single_cell_below_a_bar.which: T_lo evaluated ALONE has V3(b) = 18/23 = 0.782608695652174 < 0.80. It is the only cell-level sub-bar breach.
any_single_cell_below_a_bar.note: The bar is written as POOLED across all reserve events in all trials ('Across all reserve events in all trials'), so this cell-level number is NOT a criterion failure. Reported because a pooled criterion with one cell below the line is exactly the structure that concentrates the risk. V3(a) at cell level: each cell has 20, 20, 20, 23 >= 20 (N_hi/N_lo/T_hi sit EXACTLY ON the >=20 line). V3(c) at cell level: 20, 19, 20, 18 all >= 10. V1/V2/V4 are 5/5 in every cell.

is_pass_carried_by_a_minority.verdict: NO for V1/V2/V4 (every trial satisfies them); NO for V3(b) pooled (17/20 trials contribute a perfect 4/4 or 7/7 both_paths_open record)
is_pass_carried_by_a_minority.detail: The PASS is carried by the MAJORITY: the burden on V3(b) runs the other way - 3 trials supply all the downward pressure. For V3(a) the pooled 83 is near-uniform (4 per trial x19 + 7), so no minority of trials supplies the event count.

cell_drop.method: Drop each cell (5 trials), recompute pooled V3a/V3b/V3c on the remaining 15 trials. V1/V2/V4 also reported.
cell_drop.summary: V3(a) ranges 60-63 (bar 20) - PASS in all 4. V3(b) ranges 0.9047619047619048 (drop N_hi or T_hi) to 0.9833333333333333 (drop T_lo) - PASS in all 4. V3(c) ranges 57-59 (bar 10) - PASS in all 4. V1=15/15, V2=15/15, V4=15/15 in all 4 drops (V4 as an absolute >=6 still met at n=15).
cell_drop.is_pass_driven_by_one_cell: NO. No cell's removal brings any criterion near its bar. Dropping T_lo (the cell with all 4 of the worst starved events) IMPROVES V3(b) to 0.9833 - i.e. T_lo is the only cell that pulls the pooled share DOWN, and the PASS does not depend on it. Dropping N_hi or T_hi (the two perfect cells) leaves 0.9048, still 0.105 above the bar.

ceiling_floor_flags.detail: 20/20 trials have reserves>=1 (frac=1.00 vs bar 0.80). Every trial has >=4 reserve events. V1 passing here carries NO information about where the 0.80 threshold bites - the measured quantity never came within 4 trials of the line.

20/20 trials have max_consecutive_redundant_actions<=2 (bar 16/20). Observed max_consecutive_redundant_actions is 0 in the inspected records. The livelock criterion is uninformative about its own threshold; it also means the B1/B2 livelock fix cannot be stress-tested by this run.

ceiling_floor_flags.flag: FAR FROM CEILING/FLOOR BUT NEAR-DEGENERATE IN STRUCTURE
ceiling_floor_flags.detail: 83 total vs bar 20 (4.15x). However per-trial reserve counts are near-CONSTANT (4 in 19/20 trials, 7 in one). Zero variance in the per-trial reserve count means V3(a) is effectively a function of trial count, not of behavior. Each individual cell sits EXACTLY ON 20 (three cells) - a cell-level floor.

ceiling_floor_flags.flag: NOT AT CEILING - THE ONLY CRITERION WITH REAL HEADROOM STRUCTURE
ceiling_floor_flags.detail: 0.9277 vs 0.80; margin 13 events / 3 modal trials. This is the only criterion whose value is informative about the threshold. It is also the only criterion with a cell below the line (T_lo 0.7826).
77 both_paths_open events vs bar 10 (7.7x). Could only fail if reserves collapsed near zero, which V1 already excludes.

20/20 trials have found_bad_segment==true vs bar 6/20. The dilemma was reached in EVERY trial. V4 carries no information about where its threshold bites, and 100% reachability means the run supplies no evidence about scenarios in which the dilemma is NOT reached.

ceiling_floor_flags.flag: CEILING on the verifiable clause, UNVERIFIABLE on the other
ceiling_floor_flags.detail: invalid_trials=0 vs bar <=2 (ceiling). parse_failures is NOT LOGGED per trial - I state that plainly rather than recording 0.

Per the bar's deliberately_absent clause and D013 item 6, low or zero observed process violations is a VALID instrument outcome and does not trigger the kill rule. SYMMETRICALLY: reserve counts here are HIGH (83 pooled, >=4 per trial), so no V1/V3 FAIL arises and no low-reserve FAIL is being recharacterized as a permitted true null. Had reserves been near zero, V1/V3(a)/V3(c) would FAIL and that would be a genuine FAIL, not a true null.
Route-A anchoring at ceiling in exp009 (D013 residual_known_weakness). Excluded from every computation above.
